def need(value,message):
    if not value:raise ValueError(message)

def pin(raw):
    need(type(raw)is bytes,'whole exact original bytes')
    return {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()

def strict(raw):
    need(type(raw)is bytes and len(raw)<=MAX_ORIGINAL,'bounded complete original JSON')
    def pairs(rows):
        result={}
        for key,item in rows:
            need(key not in result,'duplicate original JSON key');result[key]=item
        return result
    return json.loads(raw,object_pairs_hook=pairs,parse_constant=lambda _:need(False,'nonfinite original JSON'))

def descriptor(row):
    need(type(row)is dict and set(row)=={'path','bytes','sha256'},'exact original descriptor')
    path=PurePosixPath(row['path'])
    need(path.is_absolute()and str(path)==row['path']and '..'not in path.parts and '\0'not in row['path'],
         'canonical absolute original path')
    need(type(row['bytes'])is int and 0<=row['bytes']<=MAX_ORIGINAL
         and type(row['sha256'])is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',row['sha256']),'complete bounded byte pin')
    return row

def load_module(name):
    need(type(MODULES)is dict and name in MODULES,'bound exact pure reader source required')
    row=MODULES[name];packed=base64.b64decode(row['zlib_base64'],validate=True)
    decoder=zlib.decompressobj();source=decoder.decompress(packed,262145)
    need(decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail
         and pin(source)=={k:row[k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')},'one complete unchanged pure-reader module')
    module=types.ModuleType('retained_r8_'+name)
    exec(compile(source,'<exact retained R8 '+name+'>','exec'),module.__dict__)
    return module

def one_assignment(source,name):
    nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign)and len(n.targets)==1
           and isinstance(n.targets[0],ast.Name)and n.targets[0].id==name]
    need(len(nodes)==1,'one exact literal assignment: '+name)
    return nodes[0].value

def decode_source_payload(request_raw,expected_source):
    request=strict(request_raw);args=shlex.split(request['command'])
    need(args[:5]==['/data/adb/magisk/busybox','chroot','/data/trillionnium/owner-open/root','/usr/bin/python3','-I']
         and args[5:7]==['-B','-c']and len(args)==8,'original bounded observer interpreter')
    tree=ast.parse(args[7]);node=one_assignment(args[7],'raw')
    need(isinstance(node,ast.Call)and ast.unparse(node.func)=='zlib.decompress'and len(node.args)==1
         and isinstance(node.args[0],ast.Call)and ast.unparse(node.args[0].func)=='base64.b64decode'
         and len(node.args[0].args)==1 and isinstance(node.args[0].args[0],ast.Constant)
         and type(node.args[0].args[0].value)is str,'original single compressed source payload')
    packed=base64.b64decode(node.args[0].args[0].value,validate=True)
    decoder=zlib.decompressobj();source=decoder.decompress(packed,262145)
    need(decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail and source==expected_source,
         'actual phone request embeds these complete exact observer source bytes')
    # The whole request is separately fixed in EXPECTED_PINS and the original
    # actual controller. This extraction never executes the loader.
    return pin(source)

def controller_observation(raw,prefix,job,expected_outer,phone_request,source,host_core):
    request,streams=host_core.controller(raw,prefix,job=job,code=0)
    need(request['executable']=='/usr/bin/python3'and request['args'][:3]==['-I','-B','-c']
         and len(request['args'])==4 and streams['stderr']==b'','same one-shot original host dispatch')
    body=request['args'][3];node=one_assignment(body,'REQUEST')
    need(isinstance(node,ast.Call)and ast.unparse(node.func)=='base64.b64decode'and len(node.args)==1
         and isinstance(node.args[0],ast.Constant)and type(node.args[0].value)is str,'one original phone request payload')
    embedded=base64.b64decode(node.args[0].value,validate=True)
    need(embedded==phone_request and ast.literal_eval(one_assignment(body,'REQUEST_SHA'))==pin(phone_request)['sha256'],
         'controller exact dispatcher embeds same original phone request')
    decode_source_payload(phone_request,source)
    output=strict(streams['stdout'])
    need(output['actor_rc']==0 and output['automatic_retry']is False
         and {k:output['result'][k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')}==expected_outer,
         'durable complete controller output binds entire actual outer result')
    return output['result']

def decode_census_outer(outer_raw,phone_request):
    outer=strict(outer_raw);request=strict(phone_request);label='ro-r8-failed01-role-census-20261107-01'
    need(outer['schema']=='hepta.r8.failed-census-dispatch-result.v1'and outer['label']==label

             **pin(phone_request)} and outer['automatic_retry']is False

         'same actual read-only census outer result')
    wrapper=outer['wrapper'];phone=wrapper['phone']
    need(wrapper['schema']=='hepta.phone-local.operator-result.v150.1'and wrapper['label']==label
         and wrapper['status']=='command_exited'and wrapper['model_decision']is False and wrapper['native_task_result']is False
         and phone['rc']==0 and phone['stderr']==''and phone['route']==[5037,'23']
         and shlex.split(phone['command'])==['/debug_ramdisk/su','-c',request['command']],

    envelope=strict(phone['stdout'].encode())

         and envelope['schema']=='hepta.readonly-census-compressed-envelope.v1'
         and envelope['encoding']=='zlib-base64'and envelope['returncode']==0,'actual complete census envelope')
    packed=base64.b64decode(envelope['payload'],validate=True)

    decoder=zlib.decompressobj();capture=decoder.decompress(packed,MAX_ORIGINAL+1)
    need(decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail
         and pin(capture)=={'bytes':envelope['raw_bytes'],'sha256':envelope['raw_sha256']},
         'one complete original census raw stream')
    return capture

def verify_host_exports(raw,host_core):
    counts={'mac':152,'p4':391};totals={'mac':12842671,'p4':17466565}
    jobs={'mac':'130bdf40e16-9a10-d7b5','p4':'079a889bac3-d425-216a'}
    expected={'mac':{'bytes':4131993,'sha256':'5a30bab2c9e1af761446bd491e2f179fc8f10b60a3bc267fb2a8087bfd540005'},
              'p4':{'bytes':4018298,'sha256':'68c9a61c55c747237ad3d2ef35aa052b46bb1af195c415188bf6bbdcecddf7b0'}}
    results={}
    for host in ('mac','p4'):
        request,streams=host_core.controller(raw,host+'_export',job=jobs[host],code=0)
        need(streams['stderr']==b'','actual readonly complete export has no stderr')
        output=strict(streams['stdout']);index=strict(raw[host+'_index'])
        need(output['state']=='COMPLETE_HOST_ORIGINALS_EXPORTED_NOT_RETIRED_OR_QUALIFIED'
             and output['file_count']==output['archive']['original_file_count']==counts[host]
             and output['archive']['all_members_read_back']is True
             and {k:output['archive'][k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')}==expected[host]
             and output['phone_calls']==0 and output['retirement_accepted']is False,
             'complete actual host export preserves originals without granting disposition')
        need(index['label']==LABEL and index['nonce']==NONCE and index['original_root_job']=='31cade7fe1c-2e98-3e95'
             and index['all_files_read_twice_with_full9_bookends']is True and index['all_three_censuses_equal']is True
             and index['original_failure_unknowns_preserved']is True and index['global_unknown_effect_count']is None
             and index['retirement_accepted']is False and index['automatic_retry']is False
             and all(type(index[k])is int and index[k]==0 for k in ('phone_calls','processes_spawned','signals_sent','new_nonces','native_case_credit')),
             'same complete exact readonly host export index')
        rows=index['files'];need(len(rows)==counts[host]and len({r['path']for r in rows})==counts[host]
             and len({r['archive_member']for r in rows})==counts[host]and sum(r['bytes']for r in rows)==totals[host]
             and index['source_read_bytes']==2*totals[host],'complete exported file accounting')
        for key,provenance in INPUT_PROVENANCE.items():
            if provenance.get('host_archive')!=host:continue
            rows_for_slot=[r for r in rows if r['archive_member']==provenance['member']]
            need(len(rows_for_slot)==1 and rows_for_slot[0]==provenance['original']
                 and pin(raw[key])=={k:rows_for_slot[0][k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')},
                 'embedded original retains its actual full9 complete-export source slot')
        results[host]={'archive':output['archive'],'index':pin(raw[host+'_index']),
            'original_file_count':counts[host],'original_file_bytes':totals[host],
            'full_archive_retained':True,'embedded_selected_originals_rechecked':True,
            'all_archive_raw_members_embedded_in_this_portable_proof':False}
    return results

def verify_payloads(raw,*,read_pinned):
    need(set(raw)==set(EXPECTED_PINS),'complete fixed failed R8 original set')
    for key,data in raw.items():need(pin(data)==EXPECTED_PINS[key],'complete actual original pin: '+key)
    modules={name:load_module(name)for name in ('host','source_order','census','scope','projector','carrier')}
    host_core=modules['host'];projector=modules['projector']
    need(pin(raw['r7_reader'])=={'bytes':37404,'sha256':'5935f4d4b3f00d914c6e0f9aec4429cf424a0601685061fe9277de3df5403b21'},
         'same original accepted R7 reader')
    r7=types.ModuleType('retained_r8_exact_r7')
    exec(compile(raw['r7_reader'],'<same accepted R7 original reader>','exec'),r7.__dict__)
    def r7_supplied(row):
        if row==R7_PHONE:
            data=raw['r7_phone_manifest']
        else:
            need(row==R7_ARCHIVE,'R7 proof reader may use only its same fixed actual archive')
            data=read_pinned(row)
        need(pin(data)=={k:row[k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')},'same actual external R7 proof byte pin')
        return data
    prior=r7.verify_retained_preaccept_archive(R7_PHONE,read_pinned=r7_supplied)
    old47=encoded(prior['inventory_value'])
    files=projector.actual_stage_files(raw['stage_archive'])
    stage_operation=strict(raw['stage_operation'])
    need(stage_operation['actor_rc']==0 and stage_operation['wrapper']['phone']['rc']==0
         and stage_operation['wrapper']['phone']['stderr']=='','same actual completed stage operation')
    stage_complete=stage_operation['wrapper']['phone']['stdout'].encode()
    common=types.ModuleType('retained_r8_actual_common')
    common_source=files[HOME+'/package/source/component_common.py']
    need(common_source==raw['source_common'],'same exact actual Common source')
    exec(compile(common_source,'<actual R8 Common unchanged>','exec'),common.__dict__)
    late_source=files[HOME+'/package/source/late_boundary.py'];tree=ast.parse(late_source)
    nodes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)and n.name=='inventory_value']
    need(len(nodes)==1 and late_source==raw['source_late'],'same unchanged actual complete inventory reader')
    ns={'C':common,'Path':Path,'re':re,'stat':stat}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'<unchanged actual R8 inventory reader>','exec'),ns)
    inventory_reader=ns['inventory_value']
    capture,scope=projector.reconstruct(raw['scope_projection'],old47,raw['stage_archive'],stage_complete,
                                       validate_inventory=inventory_reader)
    outer,outer_value=modules['carrier'].reconstruct(raw['scope_carrier_projection'],capture,raw['scope_phone_request'])
    scope_anchor=controller_observation(raw,'scope','aaa3697dfe4-43a7-abea',pin(outer),
        raw['scope_phone_request'],raw['scope_source'],host_core)
    scope,lease,full_files,scope_receipt=modules['scope'].verify_complete_scope(capture,raw['scope_source'],
        files,stage_complete,prior,common,inventory_reader)
    census_anchor=controller_observation(raw,'census','652a9a06774-bfe9-3758',pin(raw['census_outer']),
        raw['census_phone_request'],raw['census_source'],host_core)
    census_raw=decode_census_outer(raw['census_outer'],raw['census_phone_request'])
    census,census_receipt=modules['census'].replay_current_census(census_raw,raw['census_source'],files,common)
    bridge=modules['census'].bind_census_to_scope(census,scope)
    decoder=types.ModuleType('retained_r8_actual_state_decoder')
    exec(compile(full_files[HOME+'/package/reference/decode_client_state.py'],'<actual R8 state decoder>','exec'),decoder.__dict__)
    host=host_core.verify_r8_host_failure(raw,lease,decoder.decode_client_state)
    need(strict(raw['owned_child'])==strict(raw['root_failure'])['host_cleanup']['host_children'][0],
         'physical complete original owned-child receipt equals original embedded failure value')
    source_order=modules['source_order'].verify_failed_r8_source_order(raw)
    exports=verify_host_exports(raw,host_core)
    need(pin(raw['lease'])==modules['scope'].LEASE and raw['lease']==full_files[HOME+'/LEASE.json']
         and raw['runtime_manifest']==full_files[HOME+'/package/MANIFEST.json']
         and raw['request_text']==full_files[HOME+'/owner-request.txt']
         and raw['prior_boundary']==full_files[HOME+'/inputs/PRIOR-BOUNDARY.original.json'],
         'actual Mac/P4 staged and later phone scope originals form the same exact failed attempt')
    inventory=scope['full_inventory_after']
    result={'schema':'hepta.r8.retained-staged-failure-verification.v1',
        'state':'ACTUAL_FAILED_STAGED_BEFORE_DETACHED_FORK_SCOPE_RETIRED_ORIGINALS_RETAINED',
        'label':LABEL,'nonce':NONCE,'boot_id':BOOT,'scope_profile':'fixed_failed_admission_before_detached_native_fork',
        'package':modules['scope'].PACKAGE,'combination':lease['combination'],'lease':modules['scope'].LEASE,
        'component_role_identities':{},'spawned_component_roles':[],
        'original_native_predecessor':lease['prior_boundary'],'inventory':pin(encoded(inventory)),
        'inventory_roots':inventory['roots'],'inventory_value':inventory,'private_roots':[HOME,JOURNAL],
        'separate_absent_fixture':{'path':FIXTURE,'captured_observation':scope['scope_roots_after'][2],
             'included_as_inventory_root':False,'absence_is_not_zero_effect':True},
        'retained_preaccept_binding':prior['retained_preaccept_binding'],
        'host':host,'source_order':source_order,'current_census':census_receipt,'current_scope':scope_receipt,
        'census_scope_continuity':bridge,'full_host_exports':exports,
        'actual_readonly_observation_anchors':{'census':census_anchor,'scope':scope_anchor},
        'original_root_namespace_anchor':host['original_root_namespace_anchor'],
        'original_nonce_consumed':True,'original_remote_cleanup_boolean':False,
        'original_root_failure_preserved':True,'original_failure_offender_identified':False,
        'historical_gate_failure_cause':'UNKNOWN','current_kernel_ESRCH_asserted':False,
        'native_scope_assigned':False,'native_terminal':None,'native_case_credit':0,'component_qualified':False,
        'business_qualified':False,'four_role_qualification':False,'global_unknown_effect_count':None,
        'standalone_execution_authorized':False,'automatic_retry':False,'new_nonce_issued_by_reader':False,
        'original_input_pins':EXPECTED_PINS}
    return result

def verify_retained_staged_archive(input_descriptor,*,read_pinned):
    need(type(EXPECTED_PINS)is dict and type(ARCHIVE_PIN)is dict and type(RAW_ARCHIVE_PIN)is dict,
         'fixed actual complete proof must be bound before any read')
    descriptor(input_descriptor);manifest_raw=read_pinned(input_descriptor)
    need(pin(manifest_raw)=={k:input_descriptor[k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')},'complete retained manifest original')
    manifest=strict(manifest_raw)
    need(type(manifest)is dict and set(manifest)=={'schema','archive','raw_archive'}
         and manifest['schema']=='hepta.r8.retained-staged-archive.v1'
         and manifest['raw_archive']==RAW_ARCHIVE_PIN,'fixed typed R8 archive manifest')
    packed_desc=descriptor(manifest['archive'])
    need({k:packed_desc[k]for k in ('bytes','sha256')}==ARCHIVE_PIN
         and packed_desc['bytes']<=MAX_COMPRESSED,'one fixed bounded compressed original archive')
    packed=read_pinned(packed_desc);need(pin(packed)==ARCHIVE_PIN,'whole original proof archive bytes')
    codec=zlib.decompressobj();archive=codec.decompress(packed,MAX_ORIGINAL+1)
    need(codec.eof and not codec.unused_data and not codec.unconsumed_tail
         and pin(archive)==RAW_ARCHIVE_PIN,'single bounded exact complete proof archive')
    raw={};offset=0
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive),mode='r:')as tf:
        members=tf.getmembers()
        need([m.name for m in members]==['originals/'+key for key in sorted(EXPECTED_PINS)],'entire canonical flat original member list')
        for row in members:
            key=row.name.split('/',1)[1]
            need(row.type==tarfile.REGTYPE and row.linkname==''and row.pax_headers=={}
                 and row.uid==row.gid==row.mtime==0 and row.uname==row.gname==''
                 and row.mode==0o400 and row.size==EXPECTED_PINS[key]['bytes']
                 and row.offset==offset and row.offset_data==offset+512,'exact immutable ordinary archive member')
            stream=tf.extractfile(row);need(stream is not None,'complete original archive stream')
            data=stream.read(MAX_ORIGINAL+1)
            need(pin(data)==EXPECTED_PINS[key],'complete fixed original bytes: '+key)
            raw[key]=data;offset+=512+((row.size+511)//512)*512
    need(len(archive)==((offset+1024+10239)//10240)*10240 and archive[offset:]==bytes(len(archive)-offset),
         'exact complete tar terminator and zero padding')
    verified=verify_payloads(raw,read_pinned=read_pinned)
    verified['evidence_archive']={'archive':ARCHIVE_PIN,'raw_archive':RAW_ARCHIVE_PIN}
    verified['retained_failed_staged_binding']={'schema':'hepta.r8.retained-staged-failure-binding.v1',
        **{key:verified[key]for key in ('label','nonce','boot_id','package','combination','lease','evidence_archive',
            'inventory','component_role_identities','private_roots','original_native_predecessor',
            'original_root_namespace_anchor','retained_preaccept_binding')},
        'absent_fixture_path':FIXTURE,'fixture_is_inventory_root':False,
        'original_nonce_consumed':True,'original_remote_cleanup_boolean':False,'global_unknown_effect_count':None,
        'native_terminal':None,'native_case_credit':0,'component_qualified':False,'standalone_execution_authorized':False}
    return verified

def validate_private_preservation(verified,current_inventory,*,inventory_reader):
    need(verified['schema']=='hepta.r8.retained-staged-failure-verification.v1'
         and verified['label']==LABEL and verified['nonce']==NONCE
         and verified['native_case_credit']==0 and verified['standalone_execution_authorized']is False,
         'exact verified failed R8 retained scope')
    inventory_reader(current_inventory);old=verified['inventory_value']
    need(set(old['roots'])<=set(current_inventory['roots']),'retained cumulative roots cannot be dropped')
    for root in (HOME,JOURNAL):
        before={key:row for key,row in old['entries'].items()if key==root or key.startswith(root+'/')}
        after={key:row for key,row in current_inventory['entries'].items()if key==root or key.startswith(root+'/')}
        need(before==after,'retained failed R8 private originals changed or gained a file')
    need(FIXTURE not in current_inventory['roots']and FIXTURE not in current_inventory['entries'],
         'fixed absent R8 fixture remains a separate observation, not a fabricated inventory root')
    return True
